notes: The 1973 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: construction contracts and design approvals.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (lighting, irrigation, Candlestick repairs, hippo fence) not curated. Not placed: the Twenty-Fourth Street mini-park contract (Tamal, $34,050, Apr 12; which mini-park unclear), the Broadway mini-park between Leavenworth and Hyde (Tamal, $27,802, Jun 14; its page has no parcel), the St. Mary's Square garage and park expansion proposal (Mar 8; outcome not legible).

findings.address_as_written: North and South Colonnades, Palace of Fine Arts
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission accepted Walter S. Johnson's offer, through the Palace of Fine Arts League, to restore the Palace's north and south colonnades, and approved the plans by Hans Gerson, architect of the original rehabilitation; Gerson said the colonnades had been an approved alternate in 1963 but were left out of the contract for want of money.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, July 12, 1973, Resolution No. 9363

raw.text: North and South Colonnades, Palace of Fine Arts
